description: This source file implements a tree traversal and rewriting pass for shader code, specifically transforming expressions involving shader storage buffer objects (SSBOs) to simplify handling in HLSL translation. It defines a class for traversing the AST and functions for applying the transformations.

classes.name: RewriteExpressionsWithShaderStorageBlockTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to identify and rewrite expressions involving shader storage buffer objects (SSBOs) for easier translation.

methods.name: IsIncrementOrDecrementOperator
methods.description: Checks if the operator is a pre/post increment or decrement.

methods.name: IsCompoundAssignment
methods.description: Checks if the operator is a compound assignment (e.g., +=, -=).

methods.name: IsReadonlyBinaryOperatorNotInSSBOAccessChain
methods.description: Checks if the binary operator is a read-only operator not in SSBO access chain.

methods.name: HasSSBOAsFunctionArgument
methods.description: Determines if function call arguments include SSBOs.

methods.name: RewriteExpressionsWithShaderStorageBlock
methods.description: Main function that applies the AST transformation pass for SSBO expression rewriting.
